newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - May 22.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on the front page of its business section on Thursday:
LAS VEGAS - Giant Food Inc announced at a shopping center industry convention here that it will expand its drugstore operations with a free-standing pharmacy chain in Washington and Baltimore.

WASHINGTON - The European Union gave official notice that it will oppose the proposed merger of Boeing Co. and McDonnell Douglas Corp. out of concern that the combined firm could crush its only remaining competitor, the European consortium Airbus Industrie.

PHILADELPHIA - US Airways Inc. told its shareholders that in the absence of an agreement with its unions to cut labor costs, the company has begun diverting millions of dollars intended for global expansion into other investments.

RICHMOND - Virginia business and education leaders attending a statewide technology summit warned that unless the state steps up its investment in technology training and education, it is undercutting its future.
